question: Can a fresh, parent-disjoint, source-native RGB-D/pose/gravity cohort provide every F1 factor target while leaving unsupported evidence UNKNOWN and learning uncertainty only from held residuals?

prelock_evidence.selection_basis: Official source metadata describing office, room, floor or hall capture; exact identity absent from prior repository use; official RGB, depth and groundtruth archive endpoint available.
prelock_evidence.role_assignment_basis: Identity-only SHA256 ordering before source payload access.

source_contract.publisher: Technical University of Munich Computer Vision Group
source_contract.gravity_rule: Median accelerometer vector within +/-0.03 s of RGB timestamp, transformed by imu_to_rgb_optical_rotation and normalized. Specific force is camera-up. Require at least 3 samples, finite nonzero norm and parent-consistent world-up receipt; otherwise all support and obstacle-boundary factors for that frame are UNKNOWN.

cohort_contract.role_rule: first 9 FIT, next 2 CHECKPOINT_SELECTION, final 2 TRAIN_CANARY
cohort_contract.orientation_rule: Within each role, even zero-based role_index is LANDSCAPE_IDENTITY and odd role_index is PORTRAIT_ROT90_CLOCKWISE.

frame_selection_contract.eligible_pair_rule: Build a unique RGB-depth matching by ascending (absolute timestamp delta, RGB row index, depth row index), accepting delta <= 0.02 s. Keep a pair only when RGB timestamp lies inside a source groundtruth bracket <= 0.10 s. Accelerometer availability never changes frame identity; it only controls support/evidence validity after selection.
frame_selection_contract.selection_rule: Sort eligible pairs by RGB timestamp, partition into three contiguous terciles, and in each tercile choose the minimum SHA256_UPPER(assignment_token + ':FRAME:' + role + ':' + parent_id + ':' + tercile + ':' + rgb_relative_path + ':' + depth_relative_path).
frame_selection_contract.pose_interpolation: Linear translation plus quaternion SLERP at RGB timestamp.

PORTRAIT_ROT90_CLOCKWISE.array_rule: numpy.rot90(array, k=-1) on RGB, depth and every dense mask/factor
PORTRAIT_ROT90_CLOCKWISE.intrinsics_rule: fx_new=fy_source; fy_new=fx_source; cx_new=H_source-1-cy_source; cy_new=cx_source; zero skew

required_invariants: Rotated K reprojects every source camera point to the exactly rotated pixel up to floating precision.
Metric z-depth is unchanged by the in-plane camera-basis rotation.
Camera-to-world points are invariant after the paired camera-basis and pose transform.
Support normal remains aligned with transformed gravity-up when valid.

continuous_label_contract.admitted_inputs: Source-native depth, source K, source pose and source accelerometer only. No Teacher pixel is admitted to F1.

dense_normal_diagnostic.rule: Backproject source depth with bound K; central 3D differences; cross product; require center/left/right/up/down metric validity; normalize and orient camera-facing.
dense_normal_diagnostic.neighborhood_provenance: Minimum provenance over every required input pixel; any UNKNOWN input makes the normal UNKNOWN.

sequence_support_identity.rule: Across the three selected source frames, collect source-depth points with source normals within 20 degrees of source gravity-horizontal, depth <= 5 m and stride 2; recover persistent world-height modes and choose the lowest persistent mode. Ambiguous or absent modes remain UNKNOWN.

support_surface.support_plane_normal_camera_xyz: Normalized source gravity-up in the output camera basis.
support_surface.camera_height_m: camera_world_height minus lowest persistent support world height; require 0.45 <= height <= 2.20 m.
support_surface.support_truth_hw: Continuous product of Gaussian point-to-plane height score and gravity-normal alignment score; height_sigma=max(0.06 m, sequence plane median absolute residual + 0.04 m); alignment reaches zero at 25 degrees and one at zero degrees.
support_surface.support_truth_valid_hw: Source metric depth and five-pixel normal neighborhood valid, source gravity and sequence support identity valid, and physical boundary probability < 0.50.

obstacle_boundary_evidence.obstacle_evidence_truth_hw: Continuous lower logistic at 0.08 m above support times upper logistic at 2.00 m times (1-support_probability); lower scale 0.04 m and upper scale 0.15 m.
obstacle_boundary_evidence.boundary_seed_rule: Source-only adjacent 3D point-to-plane residual is mandatory. residual_tolerance=0.01+0.015*min(z_pair); point_plane_strength=clip((score-0.15)/0.30,0,1); normal jump above 20 degrees and support transition may only strengthen the seed by at most 25 percent; seed threshold is probability >= 0.50.
obstacle_boundary_evidence.boundary_distance_px_hw: Euclidean distance_transform_edt to the nearest valid boundary seed, capped at 32 px, after orientation transform.
obstacle_boundary_evidence.evidence_truth_valid_hw: Both adjacent source metric points, both five-pixel source normal neighborhoods, source gravity, sequence support identity and obstacle height are valid; all other pixels are UNKNOWN and distance is NaN.

continuous_label_contract.unsupported_value_rule: Serialize explicit validity=false; factor value loss and uncertainty loss are exactly zero. UNKNOWN is never a negative example.

provenance_contract.derived_closure: A deterministic transform never upgrades weak evidence. Every derived pixel or scalar receives the weakest provenance and validity among every required source input, neighborhood, gravity sample and sequence-height receipt.

depth.proper_score: Gaussian NLL on valid source-native residuals

support.residual: signed source point-to-frozen-support-plane residual in metres on support-valid pixels, parent-aggregated
support.proper_score: Gaussian NLL on valid source-native residuals

boundary.residual: predicted boundary localization distance to nearest source-native boundary seed in output pixels
boundary.proper_score: Gaussian NLL on valid source-native boundary residuals

uncertainty_contract.homoscedastic_baseline: For each uncertainty family independently, fit one positive sigma using FIT residuals only; freeze it before CHECKPOINT_SELECTION and TRAIN_CANARY evaluation.
uncertainty_contract.evaluation: Parent-macro proper-score gain over the frozen homoscedastic baseline plus nondecreasing observed absolute residual across frozen predicted-uncertainty quantiles.

frontdoor_gates.condition: Every bound repository file exists and matches its SHA256.
All 13 TGZ archives match frozen identity, content length and post-download SHA receipts; every required metadata and pixel member exists.
Identity-hash assignment yields 9/2/2 parent-disjoint roles; selection and canary each contain one identity landscape and one exact rotated portrait parent.
Exactly three pre-outcome metadata-selected source frames per admitted parent and 39 total frames.
Every frame serializes every F1 supervision field, factor-specific validity and provenance plus all required receipts; Teacher provenance count is zero.

At least 12 parents are joint-factor parents; at least 8 FIT parents and both CHECKPOINT_SELECTION and both TRAIN_CANARY parents have nonzero valid depth, support-plane, support, obstacle-evidence and continuous-boundary supervision.
Any missing sensor, neighbor, gravity, pose, support identity or provenance input produces explicit UNKNOWN and zero factor/uncertainty loss, never a negative label.
No proxy sigma is used as target, weight or selector; all uncertainty families use valid held residuals and a FIT-only homoscedastic baseline.
No task state, clearance, occupancy, risk, reducer output, Development outcome or model output enters source selection or supervision.

unique_successor.scope: Download and hash the frozen 13-source roster, select frames from metadata, materialize source-only F1 labels, and evaluate the nine frontdoor gates. Do not create a model or optimizer.

claim_ceiling: A frozen source-native SuperTeacher-to-AG supervision contract and permission to materialize labels only. It is not a learned model, F1 execution, factor learnability, reducer task utility, deployment, product or safety evidence.
